snippet.title: Hack 'n' Stack Launch Trailer on Steam & Switch
snippet.description:
Physics meets tower defense in this chaotic party game for 1 to 4 players. Craft barricades and turrets with whatever you can find. But beware: relentless waves of enemies are coming to tear down everything you build.

Play solo or jump into classic, chaotic couch co‑op with up to four players or take the adventure Online! Your mission: save the Kingdom by activating the 24 emitters that repel the invading forces and become the Kingdom Saviors!
